observations: Exact visible ClassPad model fx-880BTG PLUS; observed 2026-11-18.
MathI and LineI entry, native bright cursor, results, return to editing, and error screens.
MathI: derivative x² at 2 and 3; sin(x) at pi/6 in radians; integral x² with ordinary, equal and reversed bounds; sums and products of x and 1/x.

LineI inserts a flat function prefix. Commas must be entered using SHIFT + close; the right arrow moves the ordinary character cursor. Missing final closing parenthesis is accepted. DEL removes the whole empty function prefix.
LineI calculus initially shows decimal output. FORMAT converts rational results to a line fraction; samples include integral x = 1/2 and sum 1/x = 11/6.
A scalar before a calculus function is implicit multiplication in both MathI and LineI.
Sigma lower > upper: Argument ERROR retains Math and angle flags; return focuses the upper bound.
Optional tolerance arguments, numerical convergence boundaries and very tall nested calculus remain separate follow-up work.
